build_mmf_package: build the mmf multimodal framework package using setuptools and python setup.py install
run_mmf_model: run an mmf model training job using the mmf_run console script entry point
predict_with_mmf: run predictions with a trained mmf model using the mmf_predict console script
clean_html_tags: create a function that strips HTML tags from raw HTML text using regex
find_package_version: extract the version string from a Python file by searching for __version__
